role: Enum of static builders that assemble an AssistantContext (user profile, today/yesterday session snapshots, recent lite sessions carrying the titles of this build's summaries, baselines, trends, analysis summary, workout history, live workout/HRV with the workout's samples, and ambient location) from inputs gathered by AssistantContextSource, for the AI assistant's system prompt. It reads the live brokers, the ambient location cache and the settings body weight through AppDependencies.current, and reads and writes the shared AnalysisSummaryCache, as its header says.
types: ContextBuilder: enum — static builders turning HRVSession/UserSettings/baseline/trend inputs into AssistantContext snapshot structs; the per-snapshot builders (from `MARK: - Builders`) sit in a same-file extension
ContextBuilder.DerivedSampleMetrics: struct — avg/max HR, avg METs, kcal, avg cadence, alpha1 mean derived from per-tick WorkoutSample series
toplevel: No globals; two same-file extensions: the per-snapshot builders (split from the enum body to keep it under the type-length limit) and the vitals/overnight-HR/sleep sub-snapshot builders.

units.does: Generates the English analysis summary for latestSession and the yesterday diagnostic first, collects their titles by session id, then builds the AssistantContext with generatedAt=now: profile (with effective VO2max), today snapshot (live training fallback/live load), yesterday snapshot (no live data), the diagnostic, recent lite snapshots carrying those titles, baselines, 7/30-day trends, the summary, workout history, the brokers' live workout and live HRV snapshots, the ambient location snapshot and the live workout's samples.
The live workout broker's current samples when it has a live (non-stale) snapshot, else nil, so the context's HR history matches its liveWorkout.

branches.effect: nil; else currentSamples()

units.does: Maps each (session, summary) pair where both are present to session.id → summary.analysisTitle.

branches.cond: pair has both session and summary
branches.effect: record the title; else skip

units.does: Computes the analysis-summary snapshot for yesterday's session via computeOrFetchSummary using the session's own sleepSnapshot as sleep input, the week of archived nights before it in recentSessions as sleep trend, its frozen trainingSnapshot and no live load, against the supplied yesterday baseline stats; nil when session nil or unanalysed.
Returns the user's manual VO2max override if set, else the HealthKit VO2max carried on the given TrainingContext when useHealthKitVO2Max is on, else nil.

branches.effect: true: return the override; false: fall through
true: return training?.vo2Max (nil when no training context); false: nil

units.does: Recent complete/paused sessions, newest first, capped at 14, as lite snapshots; each carries the title from `titles` (the summaries generated in this build) or none.

Reads the ambient location service's cached raw CLLocation and resolved road address (both max 600 s old) and builds an AmbientLocationSnapshot with road, cross street, locality, subdivision, admin area, country, heading, speed, altitude, accuracy and age; nil when neither is cached.

branches.effect: false: return nil (no location in context); true: build snapshot
subdivision falls back to subLocality, then areaOfInterest, else nil
no fix maps to -1 so the ternary yields nil
true: headingDegrees = course; false (CoreLocation invalid -1 or no fix): nil
no fix maps to -1 so the ternary yields nil
true: speedMS = speed; false: nil

units.does: Maps a course in degrees to an 8-point compass label (N..NW) by (course+22.5) mod 360 / 45; nil for nil or negative course.

branches.effect: false: return nil; true: compute index clamped to 0...7

units.does: Returns seconds since the raw fix's timestamp, else since the resolved address's observedAt, else nil.

branches.effect: true: return age of the raw fix (even when the address is newer); false: fall through
false: return nil; true: return age of the address

units.does: Resolves the session's training context (trainingContext(for:live:)), then inside NarrativeLanguage.english hashes every other generator input (generatorInputsHash) into AnalysisSummaryCache.fingerprint(for:inputs:) and looks the summary up by session id + that fingerprint; on a hit maps it, on a miss runs AnalysisSummaryGenerator (canonical baseline RMSSD = exp(lnRmssdMean), baseline HR), stores it under that fingerprint (beside any display-language entry of the same session) and returns the mapped snapshot.

branches.effect: false: return nil (no summary in context); true: continue

branches.cond: cache has an entry for (session.id, fingerprint incl. all generator inputs)
branches.effect: true: return mapped cached summary; false: generate, cache, return

units.does: Hashes what AnalysisSummaryGenerator reads besides the session: each recent session's id and AnalysisSummaryCache.fingerprint(for:), the sleep input and sleep trend (combineSleep), and the training context, live load and baseline stats (combineLoad).
Feeds the sleep input's total/in-bed/deep/REM/awake minutes and efficiency, and the sleep trend's averages, trend and night count, into the hasher.

Feeds the training context's ATL/CTL/TSB/yesterday TRIMP, VO2max and days since a hard workout, the live load's ATL/CTL/TSB, ACWR and today's TRIMP, and the baseline stats' ln-RMSSD mean/SD, HR mean/SD and days in window, into the hasher.

Copies an AnalysisSummary into an AssistantContext.AnalysisSummarySnapshot (title, diagnostic score, explanation, probable causes with confidence/explanation, key findings, actionable steps, trend insight).

Builds UserProfileSnapshot from settings: age, sex, fitness level, effective VO2max, typical sleep, custom tags, effective max HR and whether it is a user override, resolved units preference, training-break state/reason, sleep/training-load integration flags, comeback mode active/day, scoring algorithm version, recompute flag, and training goal with blurb.

branches.effect: nil maxHR falls back to 0, giving maxHRIsUserOverride=false; a stored value at or above the minimum gives true

units.does: Returns whole calendar days from the comeback start date to today when comeback mode is active, else nil.

branches.effect: false: nil; true: day difference (0 on the start day)

units.does: Filters sessions to sessionType .workout, sorts newest first, keeps 30, maps each to a WorkoutHistoryEntry.

Builds a WorkoutHistoryEntry for one workout session from its workoutMetadata and per-tick samples: sport, active (un-paused) duration from WorkoutActiveTime (last sample offset, else wall clock) — the same time the workout card uses — distance, elevation, avg HR (analysis meanHR else sample average), max HR, pace and kcal over the active duration, TRIMP/hrTSS/decoupling, METs, power metrics, cadence, alpha1 mean, 1/2-minute HRR drops, feeling and note.

branches.effect: active time = last offset; else wall-clock duration (nil without endDate)
no metadata/samples: derive from an empty series (all derived values nil)
no metadata: sport reported as "unknown"
no HRV time-domain meanHR (typical for workouts): average of sample HRs, nil if none

units.does: Computes max HR, mean HR, mean METs, kcal (via estimatedCalories), rounded mean cadence and mean alpha1 from the non-nil values of a WorkoutSample series.
reads: mem:SettingsManager.settingsSnapshot (via estimatedCalories; in-memory snapshot, not a UserDefaults read here)

branches.effect: true: avgHR = mean; false: avgHR nil
true: avgMETs = mean; false: nil (so kcal nil)
true: avgCadenceSpm = rounded mean; false: nil
true: alpha1Mean = mean; false: nil

units.does: Compendium kcal = METs*3.5*weightKg*minutes/200 using the CURRENT settings' effectiveBodyWeightKg (75 kg fallback); nil without METs or positive duration.

branches.cond: avgMETs non-nil and durationSec non-nil and > 0
branches.effect: false: nil; true: compute kcal

units.does: Returns duration*1000/distance (sec per km) when distance > 100 m and duration > 10 s, else nil.

branches.effect: false: nil; true: pace

units.does: Builds a full SessionSnapshot: ids/dates/type, recovery score and tier, factor snapshots, English penalties, English score message, time/frequency/nonlinear/ANS metrics, overnight HR, sleep, vitals, training snapshot, tags, notes, morning feeling and tags, HRV quality, perceived readiness, artifact %.

branches.effect: no breakdown: empty penalties
no tags: empty list

units.does: Maps an analysis result's time-domain values (RMSSD, measured SDNN and pNN50 — nil when estimated —, meanRR, meanHR) to a snapshot; nil when result nil.
Maps the optional frequency-domain result (LF, HF, LF/HF, total power) to a snapshot; nil when result or frequencyDomain nil.
Maps nonlinear metrics (SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2 each nil when estimated; DFA a1/a2, sample entropy) to a snapshot; nil when result nil.
Maps ANS metrics (stress, PNS, SNS, readiness, respiration rate, nocturnal HR dip) to a snapshot; nil when result or ansMetrics nil.
Returns the session's frozen trainingSnapshot if present, else the live TrainingContext only when the session's end (or start) date is the same calendar day as now, else nil.

branches.effect: true: return frozen; false: fall through
no endDate: use startDate as the session day

branches.cond: sessionDay is the same day as now
branches.effect: true: return live; false: nil (no other day's load)

units.does: Resolves the session's training context via trainingContext(for:live:) and maps ATL/CTL/TSB/ACWR/yesterday TRIMP/days since hard workout/VO2max to a TrainingSnapshot; nil when none.
Maps the score breakdown's factors to ScoreFactorSnapshots with English detail text in Celsius, score, weight, impact string and contribution; empty when no breakdown.

branches.effect: no breakdown: empty array

units.does: Builds a SessionSnapshotLite: date, type, stored 0–10 score, RMSSD/mean HR/stress index, sleep minutes and stages (core derived), feeling, tags, frozen training load, the given analysis title (nil unless this build generated the session's summary), the English score message and nocturnal dip.

Returns the breakdown's English advice message worded with TrainingAdviceGate's load level, using the live load only for a session from today (frozen trainingSnapshot or analysisResult.trainingContext otherwise); nil without a breakdown.

branches.effect: false: nil; true: continue
no endDate: test startDate for today
true: pass liveLoad to preferring; false: pass nil so frozen is used
no frozen snapshot: fall back to the analysis result's training context, else nil

units.does: Returns core-sleep minutes: the sum of per-segment coreSleepMinutes when positive, else total - deep - REM clamped at 0, else nil when any of those is missing.

branches.effect: true: sum segment core minutes; false: skip to guard (returns nil)
true: return summed; false: fall back to subtraction

branches.cond: total, deep and REM all non-nil
branches.effect: false: nil; true: max(0,total-deep-rem)

units.does: Builds a BaselineSnapshot from recovery baseline stats (ln RMSSD mean/SD/CV, HR baseline/SD, days in window, last date) and legacy baseline values (RMSSD, SDNN, DFA a1, stress); nil when both inputs nil.

branches.effect: false: nil; true: build
no stats: daysInWindow 0

append; else omitted
append; else omitted
append; else omitted

Maps a ScoreFactor.Impact to "positive"/"neutral"/"negative".

"neutral"

Builds an OvernightHRSnapshot from the analysis result's whole-recording nadir/min/max/mean HR, with nadir wall-clock time from rrSeries mapping when loaded, else startDate + offset; nil if any of the four values is missing.

branches.effect: false: nil; true: build

units.does: Maps the session's SleepData to a SleepSnapshot: total, in bed, deep, REM, awake minutes, measured efficiency converted from percent to fraction (nil when wake unmeasured), short-sleep flag (0 < total < sleepShortMinutes) and fragmented flag (awake > threshold); nil without sleep.
